## Installation

You can install the development version of happyR from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("heike/happyR")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(happyR)
## basic example code

hello()

hello("World")
```
